cells.name: lambert
cells.species: Lambert: albedo/π · n·l — the reference diffuse

cells.name: half_lambert
cells.species: Valve's half-Lambert: (½ n·l + ½)² — no black terminator

cells.name: wrap
cells.species: wrap lighting: (n·l + w)/(1 + w), light bleeds past the terminator

cells.name: oren_nayar
cells.species: Oren–Nayar rough diffuse: flat-lit like clay or the moon
eq: f = ρ/π·(A + B·max(0, cos Δφ)·sin α·tan β)
α = max(θₗ, θᵥ),  β = min(θₗ, θᵥ),  σ = 0.06…1

cells.name: burley
cells.species: Disney/Burley diffuse with the retro-reflective grazing term

cells.name: minnaert
cells.species: Minnaert's lunar model: (n·l · n·v)^(k−1) darkens the limb

cells.name: lommel_seeliger
cells.species: Lommel–Seeliger: 1/(n·l + n·v), the classic regolith law

cells.name: hemisphere
cells.species: hemisphere ambient alone: sky tone above, ink below

cells.name: phong
cells.species: Phong: (r·v)^n, normalized

cells.name: blinn_phong
cells.species: Blinn–Phong: (n·h)^n, normalized

cells.name: gaussian
cells.species: a Gaussian lobe in the half-angle

cells.name: beckmann
cells.species: Beckmann distribution with Schlick Fresnel

cells.name: ggx
cells.species: GGX / Trowbridge–Reitz: the long-tailed lobe

cells.name: gtr
cells.species: Burley's GTR: γ = 1 Berry, γ = 2 GGX, higher is tighter

cells.name: cook_torrance
cells.species: Cook–Torrance: GGX D · Smith G · Schlick F, energy-split diffuse
eq: f_s = D·G·F/(4(n·v)(n·l)),  D = GGX,  G = Smith G₁(l)G₁(v)

cells.name: kelemen
cells.species: Kelemen–Szirmay-Kalos: G/(4 n·l n·v) ≈ 1/(v·h)²

cells.name: ward
cells.species: Ward's anisotropic Gaussian, brushed around y

cells.name: ashikhmin_shirley
cells.species: Ashikhmin–Shirley anisotropic Phong with its coupled diffuse

cells.name: ggx_aniso
cells.species: anisotropic GGX: αx/αy stretched by an anisotropy knob

cells.name: gem_prism
cells.species: chromatic gem specular: one Blinn lobe per channel, wide red, mid green, tight blue, so the highlight fringes like a prism
eq: the red lobe is wide and blue tight, so the edge fringes

cells.name: facet_glint
cells.species: micro-facet glint: a tight lobe on a hashed tilted normal per facet, gated by a hash, twinkling on a slow sine

cells.name: fresnel
cells.species: Schlick Fresnel alone: reflectance rising toward the limb

cells.name: metal
cells.species: dielectric (left) vs metal (right): F0 from albedo, no diffuse

cells.name: clearcoat
cells.species: Disney clearcoat: a sharp GTR₁ lobe over a rough base

cells.name: sheen
cells.species: Charlie sheen (Estevez–Kulla): velvet's bright grazing rim

cells.name: subsurface
cells.species: Disney subsurface approximation plus a wrapped back-light
eq: F_ss = mix(1, F_ss90, (1 − n·l)⁵)·mix(1, F_ss90, (1 − n·v)⁵),  F_ss90 = (l·h)²r

cells.name: thin_film
cells.species: thin-film interference: soap-bubble iridescence by film thickness
eq: I(λ) = ½ + ½ cos(2π·OPD/λ + π),  λ = 650, 550, 450 nm

cells.name: toon
cells.species: cel shading: banded diffuse, hard specular, hard rim

cells.name: gooch
cells.species: Gooch cool-to-warm technical illustration
eq: c = mix(k_cool, k_warm, ½ + ½ n·l) + 0.6·(r·v)³²

cells.name: rim
cells.species: Fresnel rim light: (1 − n·v)^p

cells.name: matcap
cells.species: a procedural matcap indexed by the view-space normal
eq: m = n.xy (the view-space normal indexes the cap)
c = mix(ink, ρ, ½ + ½m_y) + cream·(e^(−12|m − h|²) + 0.12g·ring)

cells.name: hatching
cells.species: cross-hatching layered by darkness, a tonal art map

cells.name: skin_lava
cells.species: lava: the 0.5 contour of flowing, domain-warped fbm splits lit crust from molten rock, with a glowing edge

cells.name: skin_galaxy
cells.species: galaxy: a screen-space starfield and fbm nebula clipped to the sphere, with a rim and a soft highlight
eq: stars: hashed points in two layers, density 0.03…0.12

cells.name: skin_holo
cells.species: hologram: scanlines, a Fresnel rim and a time-stepped band glitch that splits the color channels
eq: step = ⌊t·(3…10)⌋,  band on when hash(band, step) > 1 − g
R and B read at ±offset,  G at ¼ offset (channel split)
